name: Cinnamon Oatmeal with Pistachios & Maple-Lime Yogurt
instructions: Add salt and water to a medium saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Wash and dry the lime; zest and juice it into a small bowl.
Once the water is boiling, stir in oats, cinnamon, and maple syrup; reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and let simmer for 3-5 minutes or until oats reach desired consistency.
Add yogurt and maple syrup to the bowl with the lime zest and juice; whisk to combine.
When the oats are done, stir in milk.
To serve, divide oats between bowls and top with lime yogurt and pistachios. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
